summary: Marion County tower that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone; no source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Smithland is a community on State Highway 49, about twelve miles northeast of Jefferson in eastern Marion County
evidence.quote: Smithland, on State Highway 49 twelve miles northeast of Jefferson in eastern Marion County

evidence.supports: Smithland was named for John Frank Smith, who moved to the site in 1842, when it was still part of Cass County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only three sources: the FFLA list (Gone, coordinates), a 2011 list tagged TFS (the page names a Texas Forest Service list of 91 towers among its sources), and the Handbook of Texas for location and the name. An earlier draft said the page does not explain the TFS tag; the page does explain it, so the story was corrected. No build date, agency, staffing, photo or removal date found. The Forest Lookouts site lists other Marion County towers under the Texas Forest Service but has no Smithland page. The story is about 110 words, close to the 120-word target, with the evidence this thin.
